# AF Credit
# Direct principal bridging lender — England and Wales
# https://af.credit

## About
AF Credit is a direct principal bridging lender providing unregulated short-term bridging finance across England and Wales. We lend our own money, make our own credit decisions, and communicate directly with borrowers and their solicitors. Rates from 0.79% per month, up to 75% LTV, loans from £26,000 to £2,000,000, terms from 3 to 24 months.

AF Credit is a trading style of Avalon Financial Limited, registered in England and Wales (Company No. 15786496). Registered with the ICO under Reference ZB729589.

## Key facts
- Direct principal lender — not a broker, not a panel lender
- Unregulated bridging finance only (England and Wales)
- Rates from 0.79% per month
- Maximum LTV: 75% of open market value
- Loan range: £26,000 to £2,000,000
- Terms: 3 to 24 months
- Valuation routes: AVM, desktop valuation, full physical inspection
- Adverse credit considered case by case
- Same-day indicative terms on qualifying cases
- Solicitors instructed within 12 hours of credit decision
- Completion from 5 working days on eligible cases
- First and second charge
- No early repayment charges (subject to 3-month minimum interest)

## Eligibility summary
AF Credit lends on: houses, flats, HMOs, uninhabitable residential, mixed residential, buy-to-let, semi-commercial, and commercial property across England and Wales. Derelict, fire-damaged, structurally compromised, and unmortgageable properties all considered. Adverse credit including CCJs, defaults, missed payments, and satisfied arrears assessed individually. Scotland and Northern Ireland are not covered.
